event: At the Overgrowth edge Callum moves a Gathering Construct for the fourth time in twenty minutes.
Mira, saber across her knees against a tree: he'd be faster without the third decimal.
The third decimal is 91% against 94%: a 4.7-meter overlap band, a 2.4-degree rotation.
"I hate you a little bit." "Noted." He locks the anchor on Jin's parallel collection path.
The construct sweeps both regrowth bands from one point, relayed back to the Refinery.
Three optimizations in one morning: the nineteen-minute offset, pre-sorting, the parallel path.
The pre-sorting was his first multi-line Script Engine edit: five lines in forty minutes.
On the way in Mira killed two vine constrictors without breaking stride.
Together they add about a quarter to base throughput: "I make a quarter more stuff, faster."
Jin is waiting, Mira says, and has been talking to his rock. Chunk is an earth elemental.
The Shardfield opens before them: Toledo's ruins in shattered glass and violet fracture lines.
Jin waits with his gutted TI-84: Chunk at his feet, Zephyr circling, Pixel on his shoulder.
He hasn't slept, his hoodie is inside out, and he has mapped the outer ring's spawn cycles.
He races through the plan until Callum says "Jin. Breathe." Twice.
"Is he always like this?" "I've known him three days. So far, yes." First run: four hours.
A crystal construct's blow cracks Chunk's shoulder and takes a third of his HP.
"Stone Skin now!" Chunk hardens; Zephyr's wind blades bite only shallowly into the crystal.
Wind and resonance share a frequency band, Callum notes; the wraiths will be worse.
A resonance wraith shrugs off Zephyr; Chunk tanks it alone four minutes, down to 41% integrity.
Pixel's scouting struggles in the refractions, and twice pulls a mob into a second group.
But it works: twenty-three crystal constructs and six resonance wraiths in four hours.
The report: twelve Echo Stones, three Residuum fragments, 47 crystal and 31 glass shards.
Relay efficiency is poor at 71.3%; Zephyr needs an answer to resonance, and Pixel more range.
But twelve Echo Stones sit warm in his inventory. The bottleneck is broken.
Jin, his MP in single digits from healing Chunk: "How'd we do?" "We have what we need."
"You told me. You were right." "Say that again. Slower."
Mira drops from her overpass perch: she killed three crystal crawlers and didn't get to count them.
She refuses auto-loot on principle: she picks up her own kills with her own hands, like a person.
"You two are like this all the time?" "We've known each other a week and a half." "That's not a no."
The Enhancement Construct takes six hours to assemble on the warehouse workbench.
Pixel dozes in a corner, Mira sharpens on the catwalk, and Jin shares the scripting session.
Echo Stones sorted by frequency, charged casings, ground glass, and the weeks-grown Flux core.
First he fuses four Echo Stones into a resonance framework, one channel per construct.
They whine and spark; Jin says offset the third by 0.7 degrees, and they lock with a click.
Next the feedback conduit, which reverses the flow: Refinery output routed back as upgrades.
He inscribes patterns learned from three thousand gathering iterations into its housing.
The logic needs twenty-four instructions; Jin routes the overflow through his talisman's buffer.
Two minds covering each other's gaps: something warm blooms in Callum's chest. He files it.
Then integration: the core slots in like a key, with glass shards wired round it as a heat sink.
Last, one Residuum fragment into the core's chamber, and the construct wakes.
A tone between music and mathematics; the table-sized lattice pulses like a mind thinking.
Mira stops sharpening, Jin stops breathing, and Pip blazes bright enough to cast shadows.
Enhancement Construct, Tier 1, slot 4 of 4, four feedback channels, the fourth left open.
The Mk.V Sentinel drops to manual oversight until Construct Affinity Rank 8 opens a fifth slot.
The first cycle takes fifty-three minutes; Loop Sight turns the warehouse into a cathedral of light.
A silver-white thread wraps the Grinder's and finds inefficiencies he never saw.
Cycle one lifts the Grinder 7.1%, 94.2% to 101.3%. "Seven percent," Jin whispers. "One. Cycle."
Cycle two lifts the Scrap Collector 4.3%; cycle three, the Refinery, 5.8%.
COMPOUND LOOP STATUS: ACTIVE. Recursive optimization begins.
Four months of invisible work, and this is the moment. The air leaves his lungs.
Gold, green and blue brighten as the silver thread cycles. The loop is closed.
Something hot and bright rises in his chest, and his hands shake on the notebook.
"I have been working toward this for four months." Jin, softly: "It's working."
Nobody has done this, Jin says: checkers on a Go board. "You did it, man."
From the catwalk Mira watches, her face unreadable.
At 11:47 PM, nine cycles in, the level-up hits: 14 to 15.

changes.note: Level 14 to 15 nine cycles after the loop closes

event: The Grinder's kills are up 19%, the Collector 14%, the Refinery 22%. His vision whites out.
Intelligence to 55, Wisdom to 58, Willpower to 30: Complexity 32.5, Idle Yield 2.16x.
He has eleven skill points; three buy Script Engine 2: ten-line scripts, variables, nesting.
The real prize: Optimization Aura (Party), +15% idle efficiency to party members within 30m.
Jin, three meters off, and Mira on the catwalk are both inside thirty meters. He activates it.
Golden light spreads through the walls; Jin goes rigid as his talisman flares.
Chunk's yield jumps, Zephyr tightens, Pixel's range grows. "Callum, what did you do?"
With fifteen percent more, Chunk can farm the Shardfield's outer ring indefinitely.
Jin whoops too loud for midnight; Pixel leaps off its perch chirping. Chunk does not react.
On the catwalk Mira is quiet: her Auto-Target, Auto-Loot and Auto-Retreat just got better.
"You just made me better. Without me doing anything." Gift or insult, she can't tell.
It amplifies the margins, he says, the background skills she has been too proud to invest in.
She laughs, short and surprised. "Too proud. You said that to my face."
Fine: his aura makes her garbage idle skills less garbage. Call her proud again, and duck.
"I will allocate for the dodge." Jin, quietly: "This is the best team I've ever been on."
Past midnight Jin sleeps on the floor with Pixel; Chunk self-repairs by the east wall.
Mira sleeps on her catwalk cot, saber in reach; Callum sits alone at the workbench.
Cycle fourteen: 4,847 Essence a day, up 81.5%, doubling about every seventy-two hours.
At seven days, 19,400 a day if it holds; in a month, a number big enough to frighten him.
He writes the date, and beneath it THE LOOP IS CLOSED, underlined three times.
Pip glows slow and warm for two full seconds, the longest ever. "Yeah," Callum says. "I know."
For four months his power was his alone; tonight he made two people better by being near them.
Pride, and belonging. He doesn't write that down. Some things are not data.
Drake plans on linear power in Barrier Hall; in the warehouse, the math has just changed.
The loop is closed, the aura lit, and the constructs hum him to sleep. The numbers climb.
